summary: SKK Holdings (now Rantizo) closed its acquisition of Rantizo, Inc.'s drone-based agricultural technology assets on October 9, 2026, per a May 1, 2026 APA. The company issued 51,966,591 Class A shares valued at $258.83 million, priced at a $4.9807 three-day VWAP, plus 2,409,300 management shares worth $12 million and 2,000,000 AGP advisory shares. Seller simultaneously acquired 1,085,264 Class B shares converted to Class A. All shares carry a six-month lock-up. A waiver deferred a $10 million capital raise and $8 million SPA payment to October 16, 2026. Watch funding completion and post-lock-up overhang.
